description: Publish a draft to its target platforms. Requires confirm: true — never call this without the user’s explicit go-ahead in the conversation. Platforms without credentials fail independently with setup instructions; "export" always succeeds and writes a ready-to-post bundle.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the user explicitly approved publishing this draft now.

platforms.description: Publish to only this subset of the draft’s platforms (e.g. test one network first).

name: publish_post
title: Publish post
